posts.title: What to Do After a Hotel Accident in Turkey
posts.summary:
A hotel accident in Turkey may involve a swimming pool, wet floor, elevator, balcony, restaurant, bathroom, spa or another part of the accommodation. The steps taken immediately after the incident may affect the availability of evidence, but personal safety and medical care should come first.

Where possible, the injured guest should obtain medical examination, report the incident to hotel management in writing, and preserve photographs, witness details, booking documents and a timely request for CCTV preservation. A document should not be signed unless its content is understood.

Depending on the booking arrangements, the guest may also notify the travel insurer, tour operator or package travel organiser. A foreign tourist who has already returned home may still request an assessment. Jurisdiction, applicable law, the responsible party and available remedies depend on the individual facts.
